Magic Notes:
Intelligence Wizard Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level W1, W2
School Specialization (Abjuration): +1 Abjuration spell slot in each spell level
Simple Somatics: Suffers no arcane spell failure risk from wearing light armor
Wisdom Cleric Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level C1
Wisdom Druid Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level D1
Aligned Spells: Cannot cast spells with an alignment opposed to own or deity's alignment
Bonded Object: Can cast a known spell through a chosen object
Channel Energy: Can restore 4d6 hit points or inflict the same amount (save Will DC 12 half) to all creatures within 30' once per day
Channel Positive Energy: Can expend 2 Lay On Hands uses to use Channel Energy effects
Copycat: Can use Mirror Image effects to create a single copy for 4 rd 4 times per day
Detect Evil: Can use Detect Evil effects at will
Empower Spell: May use +2 spell slot to increase chosen spell variable effects by 50%
Lay On Hands: Touch restores 2d6 hit points once per day; use on undead instead inflicts HP
Mercy: Lay On Hands also removes fatigued
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Protective Ward: R10' Allies gain a +1 deflection bonus to Armor Class for 2 rd 5 times per day
School Opposition (Enchantment): Casting Enchantment spells requires two spell slots each
School Opposition (Necromancy): Casting Necromancy spells requires two spell slots each
Scribe Scroll: May create scroll of any known spell
Speak With Animals: Can use Speak With Animals effects for 7 rd per day
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
Spontaneous Casting (Druid): Can cast Summon Nature's Ally spells in place of prepared spells
Widen Spell: May use +3 spell slot to dbl chosen spell area of affect
Wild Shape: Can change into a small to medium animal for 4 hr once per day
